expected: See finding proposed behavior and recorded policy
actual: day_of_week99 can never satisfy getDay comparison; nonpositive custom interval can move backward indefinitely. Intentionally not executed to avoid hanging the machine.

expected: See finding proposed behavior and recorded policy
actual: Present+late+absent completed fixture computes admin33%, parent67%; adding unmarked completed produces parent dashboard50% versus attendance67%. Cancellation representation also removes absent lessons from completed-only denominators.

expected: See finding proposed behavior and recorded policy
actual: Classes This Month counts every class after month start, including December in November; agenda compares UTC date(timestamp) to MYT today.

expected: See finding proposed behavior and recorded policy
actual: On same UTC date ISO T sorts after SQLite space:01:00 lesson compares greater than now15:00. Other views use ISO bounds and exclude it.

expected: See finding proposed behavior and recorded policy
actual: Parent has eight future classes but query LIMIT5 and UI says five upcoming; detail invoice total caps at10.

expected: See finding proposed behavior and recorded policy
actual: Recorded prior Q5 allows latest submission replacing previous; UI removes form after first turn-in. Direct upsert changes content but leaves grade/graded_at, implying new content was graded.

expected: See finding proposed behavior and recorded policy
actual: Save A starts; user types B; A finishes and marks all text saved; leave before B debounce skips save and unmount cancels timer. DB keeps A. No delayed-network browser execution yet.

expected: See finding proposed behavior and recorded policy
actual: TopicSelector snapshots props once; createTopic refreshes props but localTopics is unchanged and returned id is discarded. Toast succeeds while new option remains absent until remount.

expected: See finding proposed behavior and recorded policy
actual: When JaaS configured, tokens authorize room wildcard while app route authorizes one class; calendar copies free meet.jit.si URL rather than app/JaaS room. External video not tested.

expected: See finding proposed behavior and recorded policy
actual: Negative hourly rates/durations and arbitrary runtime status strings pass Number/TypeScript-only checks. Numeric grade999/100 bypasses native validation because Return is not a form submit.

expected: See finding proposed behavior and recorded policy
actual: Quick cancel notifies, form cancel does not; direct reschedule/recurrence omit class notifications; report variants invalidate different surfaces. Already-open role pages have no realtime updates.

expected: See finding proposed behavior and recorded policy
actual: Only immediate confirmation Notification exists. There is no reminder scheduler, push subscription or service worker; UI promises notifications before upcoming classes.

expected: See finding proposed behavior and recorded policy
actual: Status badges have hover/cursor styling but no click handler, link or query filter; table always renders all invoices.

expected: See finding proposed behavior and recorded policy
actual: UI says2MB; server rejects above512000bytes. A700KB image meets UI promise and fails save.

expected: See finding proposed behavior and recorded policy
actual: Values beginning =,+,-,@ can be interpreted as formulas by spreadsheet software; quoting delimiters does not neutralize formulas. Inputs are largely admin-entered, so risk depends on trusted-data assumptions.

expected: See finding proposed behavior and recorded policy
actual: maximumScale1 restricts zoom in browsers that honor it. Actual assistive-device behavior was not tested.

expected: See finding proposed behavior and recorded policy
actual: README describes no accounts/local better-sqlite3 although current code requires libSQL URL and login; security docs describe old session store and middleware guarantees. Historical audit marks /api removed but current middleware includes it.

explanation: Canceled class is included as zero-amount line; completed/absent class billed80 because generation checks status not attendance. Total160 rather than80.

DELETE classes WHERE recurrence_id AND scheduled removes both past and future scheduled rows; completed row survives with recurrence_idNULL due FK ON DELETE SET NULL. Requirement is cancellation of future rows only while preserving history.
